title: British gravity research memo stamped Wright-Patterson with missing pages
summary: Greg Bishop tells of British gravity research memo stamped Wright-Patterson with missing pages, about mid-20th century at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Ohio, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the copy I saw was stamped right Patterson Air Force Base on it and it missed about like five pages like there's this big legend about the missing five pages about where it's like it was achieved in the mid-century in and then it cuts off

plain: A writer and researcher named Greg Bishop says on Jesse Michels's podcast that he saw a copy of a British memo about gravity research that was stamped with the name of Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio. He says about five pages were missing, and that there is a legend that those pages describe something achieved in the middle of the last century before the text cuts off. If true, it would hint that a gravity breakthrough was hidden.
